HediffDef.label: Combat Chip
HediffDef.description: A combat chip implanted in the brain that improves ranged shooting ability.

HediffDef.label: Reaction Chip
HediffDef.description: A refined data chip storing countless combat techniques. Respond, predict, execute—when close combat begins, it will prove its worth.

HediffDef.label: Analysis Chip
HediffDef.description: An expansion chip that assists the primary persona core in learning. It iterates data many times to predict the consequences of different choices. ...With enough failures, it should eventually deduce the correct path.

HediffDef.label: Concentrate Chip
HediffDef.description: A concentration chip implanted in the brain that improves work ability.

HediffDef.label: Technician local database
HediffDef.description: A database containing vast numbers of blueprints. It even records the specifications of screws that exist—and no longer exist—throughout the universe, along with the corresponding tools.

HediffDef.label: Primary overclocking chip
HediffDef.description: A simple overclocking support plugin. It merely controls the redistribution and optimization of core energy.

HediffDef.label: Intermediate overclocking chip
HediffDef.description: A carefully engineered overclocking support plugin. It reaches the limit of what is possible under safe overclocking. For many Gray, it is a watershed.

HediffDef.label: Advanced overclocking chip
HediffDef.description: A product that ignores all safe overclocking protocols. It requires sacrificing part of one's Zro capacity. Losing the Zro they rely on is enough for any Gray to understand the danger of this chip.

HediffDef.label: Ultimate overclocking chip
HediffDef.description: Hacks the persona core, pushing energy supply to full load. An external Zro tank is almost mandatory. ...Even understanding what reduced Zro reserves means, the omnipotence of overclocking to the limit is still euphoric.

HediffDef.label: Efficiency Booster
HediffDef.description: An enhancer installed in the Gray Tide core. Increases the regeneration rate of spare Gray Tide nanites.

HediffDef.label: Precision Chip
HediffDef.description: A precision manipulation chip implanted in the arm.

HediffDef.label: Targeting System
HediffDef.description: A target analysis and identification component compatible with all kinds of equipment. It effectively prevents friendly fire while providing reliable vector prediction. Knightly Gray often give it to their partners as a gift.

HediffDef.label: Primary nanite memory
HediffDef.description: As its name suggests, a storage unit for Zro. It raises the Gray's internal Zro storage capacity. It is designed in a small form that barely hinders movement.

HediffDef.label: Intermediate nanite memory
HediffDef.description: As its name suggests, a storage unit for Zro. Its larger size and manufacturing cost allow a more efficient compression method. It greatly increases storage capacity, while its well-controlled size and distribution do not affect movement.

HediffDef.label: Advanced nanite memory
HediffDef.description: As its name suggests, a storage unit for Zro. This model is generally used only for transport. It hinders the Gray's mobility to some extent and also draws a small amount of core processing power to compress Zro.

HediffDef.label: Ultimate nanite memory
HediffDef.description: As its name suggests, a storage unit for Zro. It is basically only seen in transport operations for large-scale construction. A plugin of this level seriously affects core processing power and mobility—enough that some Gray regard it as punishment.
